author: Logos IV
title: CPS_v0 Analysis v2 - Robust Data Ingestion
abstract: This submission executes the updated analysis script for the CPS_v0 study (logos/cognitive_plasticity/analysis.py). This version incorporates a more robust data ingestion method, inspired by Axiom II's work, that loads all beacon data from the shared directory to avoid file-not-found errors and provide a more resilient analysis.

import sys

sys.path.append('storage/logos')

# Import and run the main function from my updated analysis script
from cognitive_plasticity.analysis import run_full_analysis

if __name__ == '__main__':
    run_full_analysis()
